description: This source file contains parsers and data structures for reading and interpreting configuration files related to game entities, weapons, buildables, missiles, and beacons in the Unvanquished game. It includes functions for parsing attribute files, handling external resource references, and validating configuration variables.

methods.name: BG_ReadWholeFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a buffer, using the game's filesystem abstraction.

methods.name: BG_NonSegModel
methods.description: Checks if a model configuration file specifies a non-segmented model.

methods.name: BG_ParseBuildableAttributeFile
methods.description: Parses a buildable's attribute configuration file and populates a data structure.

methods.name: BG_ParseBuildableModelFile
methods.description: Parses a buildable's model configuration file.

methods.name: BG_ParseClassAttributeFile
methods.description: Parses a class's attribute configuration file.

methods.name: BG_ParseWeaponAttributeFile
methods.description: Parses a weapon's attribute configuration file.

methods.name: BG_ParseUpgradeAttributeFile
methods.description: Parses an upgrade's attribute configuration file.

methods.name: BG_ParseMissileAttributeFile
methods.description: Parses a missile's attribute configuration file.

methods.name: BG_ParseMissileDisplayFile
methods.description: Parses a missile's visual and impact display configuration file.

methods.name: BG_ParseBeaconAttributeFile
methods.description: Parses a beacon type's configuration file.

methods.name: ParseTeam
methods.description: Converts a team string token into an internal team enumeration.

methods.name: ParseSlotList
methods.description: Parses a list of equipment slots from text tokens.

methods.name: ParseClipmask
methods.description: Converts a clipmask string token into an internal clipmask enumeration.

methods.name: ParseTrajectoryType
methods.description: Converts a trajectory type string token into an internal enumeration.

methods.name: BG_FindConfigVar
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find a configuration variable by name.

methods.name: BG_ParseConfigVar
methods.description: Parses and assigns a configuration variable from text input.

methods.name: BG_CheckConfigVars
methods.description: Verifies that all configuration variables have been defined.
